title: Could Palantir Be the Next Stock Added to the Dow Jones?
author: Will Healy
description: While Palantir Technologies meets all stated criteria for Dow Jones inclusion—including S&P 500 membership, U.S. headquarters, and appropriate stock price—the article argues inclusion is unlikely in the near term. The company faces stiff competition from better-established Magnificent Seven stocks and former Dow components, and its relative youth (only 6 years post-IPO) may require a longer track record before serious consideration.

title: Edge Cloud Orchestration Market Accelerates as AI, 5G and Distributed Computing Increase Demand for Automated Infrastructure Management

title: HPE's Networking Orders Signal Continued Growth: What's Ahead?
author: Na
description: Hewlett Packard Enterprise's networking revenues jumped 74.9% year-over-year to $2.89 billion, driven by strong AI infrastructure demand and the Juniper acquisition. The company secured a gigawatt-scale Oracle deal and reported Networks for AI orders of $700 million in Q3. HPE trades at a valuation discount despite 159.4% YTD stock appreciation and holds a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong 74.9% YTD networking revenue growth, successful Juniper acquisition integration ahead of schedule, major Oracle gigawatt-scale deal, elevated AI orders ($2.2B cumulative), raised fiscal 2026 guidance to $2.5-$3B, and Zacks Rank #1 Strong Buy rating with upward estimate revisions.

title: AI Data Center Interconnect Market Expands as Distributed AI Workloads Drive Demand for High-Speed Optical Connectivity

title: DELL Rides on Growing AI Clientele: Can the Stock Outpace SMCI & CSCO?
author: Zacks.Com
description: Dell Technologies is capitalizing on surging AI infrastructure demand with over 6,500 AI Factory customers and a $95B backlog.
